coverage.note: Coverage describes matching Git/GitHub mail surfaced by Gmail queries, not a cryptographic proof that no other nonmatching message exists.

reverse_pass_new_findings.finding: GitHub required additional verification for a sign-in from an unrecognized device.
reverse_pass_new_findings.promotion_rule: Do not classify as compromise without owner/security-log corroboration.

reverse_pass_new_findings.finding: GitHub secret scanning reported Google API Key exposures in aura-oracle-tg, iNaiHR and iNaiHR-Janus-, followed by a Telegram Bot Token finding in Janus during 2025-11-24 through 2025-12-17.
reverse_pass_new_findings.warning: Historical detection does not prove the credentials remain valid now.

reverse_pass_new_findings.finding: A two-factor lockout recovery request was initiated and completed on 2026-01-16, then cancelled on 2026-01-17 after GitHub detected a successful authentication event.
OAuth/application grants observed include Groq Console, UIFlowOAuthApp, Git Credential Manager, xiaozhi and later Tranceptor Technology, with varying read/repo/workflow scopes.
reverse_pass_new_findings.promotion_rule: Treat each grant as normal only if intentionally authorized and still required.

reverse_pass_new_findings.finding: Append-only mutation memory used read-entire-file then replace semantics without serialization, so concurrent evaluators could silently drop experiment/failure records.

Portable-state verification checked signed source payload but did not recompute and cross-check derived confidence, authority and projection fields, permitting corrupted derived state to retain a valid signature result.

Conflict and corroboration logic read controller_cluster although stored identity binding used controller_proof_sha256, weakening own-source conflict checks and allowing same-controller accounts to appear independent.
A supersedes_assessment_id could point to any existing assessment rather than the semantic predecessor, allowing unrelated authority records to be revoked.
Complete gate was promoted TRUE while reproducible implementation, frozen inputs, raw per-case outputs and proof-validation artifacts were not present in the reviewed tree.
Workflow compared the assembled firmware against a stale/wrong hard-coded checksum, causing the measurement workflow to fail before intended compilation.
Choice parser could interpret ordinary standalone article 'a' as answer A and produce false pass/fail results.
Wrapper validated one read of config/reference/pack, then execution reparsed file paths, so consumed bytes could differ from the bytes carrying VERIFIED provenance.
Reviewer collection admitted a submission protocol by schema equality rather than frozen canonical content identity, allowing expected digests to be altered under the same schema.
Package verifier ignored ZIP members outside the detected package prefix, so extra top-level evidence could coexist with EXACT_CANONICAL_CONTENT_MATCH.

Physical-gate join accepted self-asserted receipt constants without trusted signature, trusted digest or underlying execution evidence; matching synthetic JSON could produce READY_FOR_FINAL_162_GAUNTLET=true without either physical run.
A one-shot workflow remained triggered for all future main PRs while requiring a fixed historical base SHA, creating a future permanently failing check after merge.
Concurrent clients could both validate the same journal head and append duplicate sequence/stale prev_hash records because verify/build/write was not protected by an interprocess lock.
status could report top-level ok=true and exit zero while nested journal verification returned ok=false.
At the newest examined reasoning boundary, model-originated independent_confirmation could still be interpreted as independent evidence and promote fact_allowed=true.

account_security_timeline_interpretation.non_inference: The sequence alone does not prove account compromise. Any event not intentionally initiated by the owner should be treated as a high-priority security investigation and correlated with GitHub Security Log.

strengthened_cross_layer_invariant.canonical: VALIDATION MUST BIND TO THE EXACT BYTES, ACTOR, EXECUTION, AND STATE THAT ARE LATER PROMOTED.
strengthened_cross_layer_invariant.compact: VERIFY THE SAME THING YOU PROMOTE.
strengthened_cross_layer_invariant.janus: FUNCTION MAY TRANSFORM — IDENTITY MUST CROSS EVERY GATE.
